Surat & Mumbai: Indian gold dealers swung to a $7-an-ounce premium, from a $6 discount a week earlier, Reuters reports, as festive buying returns. Domestic gold traded near Rs1,48,200 for 10 grams. Investors still hold back, CapsGold's Chanda Venkatesh says; large mutual funds suspended bulk gold ETF subscriptions on 15 October, naming no reason.

સુરત માટે: ભારતીય સોના વેપારીઓ ડિસકાર્ટમાંથી $7 પ્રીમિયમ પર આવ્યા, તહેવારની માંગથી.

Full story on caratcapital.org, link in bio. Photos via Wikimedia Commons. Source: Reuters via Kitco, 16 Oct.

Gold in Surat: 24K Rs12,583/g, silver Rs1,74,603/kg -- 21 Oct tape, USD/INR 95.
